title: BTS and Spider-Man: Brand New Day Top 2026 Kids' Choice Awards
excerpt: BTS swept the music awards with three blimps and Spider-Man: Brand New Day took Favorite Movie at the 2026 Kids' Choice Awards on November 14.
content:
BTS and Spider-Man: Brand New Day were the big winners at the 2026 Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards on Saturday, November 14, live from CBS Television City in Los Angeles.

The 39th annual ceremony, hosted by Alex Warren, aired simultaneously on Nickelodeon and CBS for the first time. Spider-Man: Brand New Day took Favorite Movie, with Zendaya named Favorite Movie Actress, Tom Holland named Favorite Movie Actor, and Sadie Sink winning Favorite Villain.

BTS swept the music categories with three orange blimps: Favorite Music Group or Duo, Favorite Song for "SWIM," and Favorite Album for ARIRANG. ROSÉ won Favorite Female Artist and Bruno Mars won Favorite Male Artist. KATSEYE took Favorite Female Breakout Artist or Group, SOMBR won the male breakout award, and Olivia Dean won Favorite Viral Song for "Man I Need."

Zootopia 2 won Favorite Animated Movie, and KPop Demon Hunters stars Arden Cho and Ahn Hyo-seop won the animated voice awards. "Golden" from KPop Demon Hunters won Favorite Song from a Movie.

Keke Palmer had a full-circle moment on the orange carpet, returning as a former Nickelodeon star, this time with her child. Her song "Big Guy" from The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants was nominated for Favorite Song from a Movie.

Sources: Entertainment Tonight; Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards.
